resources.title: Azure Fundamentals Key Terms Glossary
resources.description: Every "Key terms" table from all 18 lessons, compiled into one document organized by chapter — a single-page review before AZ-900, and a lookup when a later course in this catalog (Azure Database Administrator, Data Factory, Terraform & Bicep, and others) assumes you already know this vocabulary.

resources.title: AZ-900 Exam Readiness Checklist
resources.description: Lesson 18's exam-area mapping turned into a working self-test: every lesson's own "Check yourself" question, grouped under the four AZ-900 scored areas, plus the exam's real format and logistics. Answer all 18 without looking back at the guide and you're at the level AZ-900 expects.

resources.title: Azure CLI Quick Reference
resources.description: The exact commands from Lesson 15 and Lesson 17 compiled into one reference, with the general az <service> <action> --<parameter> pattern spelled out so an unfamiliar command reads piece by piece instead of needing a fresh lookup every time.

resources.title: New Environment Deployment & Governance Checklist
resources.description: A before-you-deploy checklist that pulls resource group naming, region choice, compute/storage choice, RBAC scope, tags, budget, and clean-up planning from Chapters 1, 2, 3, and 4 into one pass, instead of making each decision in isolation partway through a deployment.
